articles.title: OpenAI合并Chat与Work，重度用户更早触限
articles.summary: OpenAI将ChatGPT的聊天和工作两种体验合并，统一用量计量，重度用户可能更早碰到使用上限。
articles.why: 对每天用ChatGPT学习或干活的人来说，免费或低价额度可能更不经用，得留意用量。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注自己常用AI工具的额度规则变化，别等用不了才发现。
articles.source_title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work

articles.title: 纽约禁售AI聊天玩具五年
articles.summary: 纽约州禁止销售AI聊天玩具五年，起因是研究发现这类玩具可能让孩子接触不当内容、影响情感发育。
articles.why: 说明AI进家庭不是装上就行，尤其涉及孩子时，安全和内容把关是真实存在的问题。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 看到“AI玩具”“AI陪伴”类产品，先问它怎么防不当内容。
articles.source_title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

articles.title: Character.AI卖用户聊天记录被州检察长拦
articles.summary: Character.AI破产出售方案包含2100多万美国账户的私密聊天数据，多州总检察长反对拍卖这些数据。
articles.why: 提醒普通人：你和AI聊的内容可能被当作资产处理，隐私不是小事。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想想自己跟AI聊天时说过什么，有没有不该留痕的内容。
articles.source_title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs

articles.title: 中国牵头AI训练数据质量国际标准被欧洲采用
articles.summary: 中国专家牵头制定的AI训练数据质量国际标准，成为30多个欧洲国家AI合规评估的技术参考。
articles.why: 数据质量是AI好坏的地基，这类标准会影响以后AI产品怎么被评估和监管。
articles.beginner_takeaway: “训练数据质量”这个词以后会常听到，可以留意它管的是什么。
articles.source_title: 中国牵头制定，人工智能训练数据质量国际标准成 30 余个欧洲国家重要技术参考

articles.title: SpaceX获准发射百万颗AI数据中心卫星
articles.summary: 美国FCC批准SpaceX部署最多100万颗搭载AI芯片的卫星，属于其“Starmind”计划，把数据中心放到太空。
articles.why: AI算力的争夺正从地面扩到太空，说明算力需求大到要另找地方。
articles.beginner_takeaway: “把数据中心送上天”听起来远，但它反映AI耗电和占地是真问题。
articles.source_title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

articles.title: SpaceX降价出租AI算力，降幅约两三成
articles.summary: 研究机构报告称SpaceX把小型GPU集群的现货租赁价下调约20%到35%，大客户Anthropic是否续约出现不确定性。
articles.why: 算力租金下降对用AI的人是好信号，但也说明算力市场供需在变。
articles.beginner_takeaway: AI服务价格背后是算力成本，可以留意这类价格变化。
articles.source_title: 降幅约 20%~35%：报告称马斯克 SpaceX 降价出租 AI 算力

articles.title: 标普考虑下调英伟达信用评级
articles.summary: 标普考虑把英伟达信用评级降至AA-，理由是公司治理和“关键人物”风险。
articles.why: 英伟达是AI芯片的核心供应商，它的治理风险会牵动整个AI行业。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 一家公司太依赖一个人，连评级机构都会担心，这是观察大公司的角度。
articles.source_title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks

articles.title: 黄仁勋否认特朗普帮他重回英伟达
articles.summary: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在全员会上向员工道歉，并否认白宫和科技领袖帮他官复原职的说法。
articles.why: 这是英伟达内部治理风波的后续，公司高层稳定与否会影响产品节奏。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 大公司的人事和治理新闻，往往比产品发布更能说明问题。
articles.source_title: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired

articles.title: Nothing新款AI耳机充电盒能录音转写总结
articles.summary: Nothing展示12月8日将发售的Ear Note耳机，充电盒可录音、转写并总结对话，带“Talk”按钮。
articles.why: 录音加自动转写总结，对听课、开会、采访这类场景很实用，但也要注意录音合规。
articles.beginner_takeaway: AI硬件正把“录音转文字”做成随身功能，想想哪些场合用得上、哪些不能录。
articles.source_title: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case

articles.title: 谷歌个性化AI视频流专利被拒但可能再提交
articles.summary: 谷歌申请“My Channel”专利，想用AI根据用户信息生成个性化视频和广告流，目前被拒，但可能修改后再申请。
articles.why: 这代表一种趋势：内容可能不再由人拍，而是AI按你的喜好现做，值得留意。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 如果视频都是AI按你喜好生成的，你看到的世界会变窄吗？
articles.source_title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

items.title_en: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
items.summary: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. items.title_cn: PyRUA-Dex：用编程智能体学习灵巧双臂操作的程序化策略
items.note: 无需示范，让编程智能体分两阶段探索并写出灵巧操作策略。

items.title_en: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
items.summary: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. items.title_cn: ROAM-Bench：通过证据验证评估具身主动空间智能
items.note: 提出新基准，在机器人运动与碰撞约束下考察主动探索与证据验证能力。

items.title_en: Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation
items.summary: Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) g
items.title_cn: 目标部件偏好优化：面向部件感知的3D生成
items.note: 用DPO偏好微调，在少量部件标注下提升3D生成的部件完整与分离度。

items.title_en: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. items.title_cn: DyLoMo-DiT：动态循环专家混合扩散Transformer
items.note: 用权重共享循环复用参数，配合稀疏专家扩展容量而不增加存储。

items.title_en: CONCOR: Benchmarking Contrastive Decoding for Visual Hallucination Mitigation Beyond Final-Output Performance
items.summary: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. items.title_cn: CONCOR：超越最终输出评估视觉幻觉缓解的对比解码
items.note: 构建基准，剥离候选过滤等因素，单独衡量对比解码对幻觉的真实作用。

items.title_en: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
items.summary: We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. items.title_cn: Antom三合一Transformer：支付基础模型
items.note: 约70亿参数支付基础模型，融合序列、表格与图表示做支付风险检测。

items.title_en: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
items.summary: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. items.note: 指出结果奖励无法教智能体何时作答，改用可验证信念信号训练。

items.title_en: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the
items.title_cn: 别睡，保持警惕：面向电脑使用智能体的主动感知
items.note: 针对截图感知滞后问题，提出主动感知以缩小电脑使用智能体的感知-行动差。

items.title_en: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
items.summary: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-strea
items.title_cn: Loom注意力：Transformer中可重连的电路
items.note: 提出loom注意力，让每个token动态重连头部电路，形成双流架构LoomFormer。

items.title_en: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
items.summary: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often
items.title_cn: ACAP：高效机器人控制的异步编程智能体
items.note: 把机器人拆成多个常驻智能体异步推理执行，缓解整体单智能体的延迟。

items.title_en: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
items.summary: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. We present Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based root-body diffusion architecture that integrates loc
items.title_cn: Motion Mamba 2.0：面向长时程人形控制的自回归扩散Mamba
items.note: 基于Mamba的根-身体扩散架构，兼顾长时程历史与实时可控动作生成。

items.title_en: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
items.summary: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce WorldLeague, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of 60 simulated robot tasks by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from t
items.title_cn: WorldLeague：物理能动性基准
items.note: 用60个仿真机器人任务，按物理目标进展比较AI系统的感知、规划与行动。

items.title_en: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
items.summary: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the roboti
items.title_cn: Embo-Harness：理解前沿模型作为策略的闭环框架
items.note: 系统研究前沿多模态模型直接充当机器人策略时，闭环框架各组件的作用。

items.title_en: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
items.summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare th
items.title_cn: 3AGameFactory-Motion：面向多样3D资产的智能绑定与可靠复杂动作生成
items.note: 提出DivDynBench，评估六类形态资产的绑定与多阶段复杂动作生成。

items.title_en: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
items.summary: Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B fo
items.title_cn: 让修复者决定：用修复者似然训练代码定位器
items.note: 用冻结修复模型给候选定位打分来训练定位器，无需跑测试或强化学习。

items.title_en: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a
items.title_cn: cmHC：通过几何收缩平衡超连接中的流混合
items.note: 研究Birkhoff多胞体内残差流混合的权衡，提出方法避免超连接退化。

items.title_en: Non-penetrating World Models
items.summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) ca
items.title_cn: 非穿透世界模型
items.note: 提出NoPeBench评估世界模型的物体穿透问题，并利用DiT隐状态加以抑制。

items.title_en: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
items.summary: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and
items.title_cn: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview技术报告
items.note: 350亿总参、30亿激活的专家混合扩散语言模型，支持思考模式生成。

items.title_en: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.summary: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM sup
items.title_cn: 通过在线自蒸馏从无标注视频学习视频前瞻推理
items.note: 用过去-未来视频对做在线自蒸馏，无需标注或大模型监督学习前瞻推理。

items.title_en: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
items.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce Me
items.title_cn: MemOnce：面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
items.note: 提出可复用记忆架构，兼顾长程交互中的细粒度信息与线性开销。

items.title_en: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a fai
items.title_cn: Mind2Act World：机器人操作中具身心智、物理行动及其组合的诊断基准
items.note: 新基准分别诊断认知推理、物理执行及二者组合，定位失败来源。

items.title_en: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
items.summary: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeV
items.title_cn: WeVisForensics：用于全能AI生成视频检测的自进化智能体
items.note: 让智能体自适应选择取证检查并自我进化，提升AI生成视频检测能力。

items.title_en: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
items.summary: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct response
items.title_cn: WeMM-Video：推进开源全模态视频理解前沿
items.note: 中英双语全模态基础模型系列，统一文本、图像、音频与视频的联合理解。

items.title_en: Posterior Matching Distillation
items.summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distributio
items.title_cn: 后验匹配蒸馏
items.note: 提出后验匹配蒸馏，缓解反向KL的模式寻求偏差，提升扩散蒸馏多样性。

items.title_en: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
items.summary: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium
items.title_cn: Coda-DaVinci：用代码转视频重新构想视频生成
items.note: 研究智能体编写3D代理引导视频生成时，代理粒度与提示的取舍。

items.title_en: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
items.summary: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent
items.title_cn: Jeveration：系统一模型现在也能生成
items.note: 基于冻结视觉语言模型，用单次前向并行预测生成高质量图像。

items.title_en: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
items.summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and loc
items.title_cn: ALIVE：让流式视频模型可交互
items.note: 构建可主动监控与协调任务的交互式流式视频模型，两阶段训练。

items.title_en: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
items.summary: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across
items.title_cn: 分辨率假说：智能体进化的关键是识别改进
items.note: 指出智能体进化停滞源于评估噪声难以可靠识别更优产物，而非提议不足。

items.title_en: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
items.summary: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at s
items.title_cn: Game2Player：通过环境与玩家协同开发扩展视觉智能体的游戏经验
items.note: 协同开发游戏环境与玩家，规模化收集多样且可验证的游戏经验。

items.title_en: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
items.summary: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formulate this setting as Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), a task that jointly refines spatial and temporal resolution while predicting future high-resolution traject
items.title_cn: PROLA：面向预测性时空天气降尺度的主正交低秩适配
items.note: 提出主正交低秩适配，低成本把预训练天气骨干用于高分辨率预测降尺度。

items.title_en: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation
items.title_cn: 从TeleChat到星火4：在国产芯片与框架上推进前沿智能体模型
items.note: 介绍在昇腾上训练的大模型系列，涵盖架构、预训练与推理智能体后训练。

items.title_en: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whos
items.title_cn: AscendGYM：面向昇腾NPU真实负载的成本感知内核优化基准
items.note: 48个内核的基准，考察智能体在真实输入配置下优化已有内核的能力。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.summary: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed archite
items.title_cn: 权重空间编程不需要Transformer
items.note: 让大模型手写目标权重而非梯度训练，实验比较Transformer与其他架构。

items.title_en: Multi-Branch Transformer
items.summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MB
items.title_cn: 多分支Transformer
items.note: 提出并行组合完整Transformer块的多分支架构，作为宽度与深度的补充扩展路径。

items.title_en: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
items.summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarnes
items.title_cn: ForceHarness：为冻结前沿模型把力转化为行动与物理
items.note: 在冻结模型之下闭环处理快速接触力，并把力转成模型可推理的形式。

huggingface.models_summary: 第 6 到 10 条里，多数是图文转文字的多模态模型，其中三个是同一款 Inkling-2-Mini 的不同版本（原版、GGUF 量化、无审查量化），说明热门模型常会衍生出适配本地运行和不同用途的变体；另有一个音频转音频模型和一个信息缺失的模型。对跟进 AI 圈和备考 AI 方向的人来说，值得注意多模态是当前主流方向，同一模型的多版本发布也很常见，看模型时要先分清原始版和社区改版。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在具身智能与机器人：灵巧操作、电脑使用智能体、世界模型、物理基准和力反馈控制；同时多模态视频理解与生成、扩散模型蒸馏与架构效率（MoE、Mamba、记忆、注意力）也很热。新手可记住关键词：具身智能、世界模型、多模态、扩散模型、MoE、强化学习、基准评测。
